meta.description: Plain-language summaries and reference links for KSP crime analytics platform sections

IPC.note: Replaced by Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) from 1 July 2024. Cases before that date continue under IPC.

302.title: Murder
302.plain_language: Causing the death of a person with intention to kill or with knowledge that the act is likely to cause death.

307.title: Attempt to Murder
307.plain_language: Attempting to cause the death of a person with intention to kill. The victim survives.
307.punishment: Up to 10 years + fine; Life imprisonment if hurt caused

323.title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
323.plain_language: Deliberately causing bodily pain, disease, or infirmity to another person (simple hurt, not grievous).
323.punishment: Up to 1 year imprisonment or fine up to ₹1,000, or both

324.title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt by Dangerous Weapon
324.plain_language: Causing bodily hurt using a knife, fire, poison, or any instrument that can cause death or grievous hurt.
324.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or fine, or both

354.title: Assault or Criminal Force on Woman (Outraging Modesty)
354.plain_language: Using assault or criminal force against a woman with the intent to outrage or knowing it will outrage her modesty.

376.title: Rape
376.plain_language: Sexual intercourse by a man with a woman without her consent or under coercion/fraud/fear.
376.punishment: Minimum 7 years, up to Life Imprisonment + fine

379.title: Theft
379.plain_language: Dishonestly taking movable property out of the possession of a person without their consent.
379.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or fine, or both

392.title: Robbery
392.plain_language: Theft or extortion with the use of or threat of force — theft that escalates to use of violence.
392.punishment: Up to 10 years + fine; 14 years if on highway

406.title: Criminal Breach of Trust
406.plain_language: Dishonestly misappropriating or converting to one's own use property entrusted to them.
406.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or fine, or both

420.title: Cheating and Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property
420.plain_language: Deceiving a person and thereby dishonestly inducing them to hand over property or to alter/destroy a valuable document.

498A.title: Cruelty by Husband or Relatives of Husband
498A.plain_language: Subjecting a woman to cruelty by her husband or his relatives — includes physical/mental harassment and dowry-related coercion.

NDPS.fullName: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985

8.title: Prohibition of Certain Operations
8.plain_language: Core prohibition section — makes it illegal to cultivate, produce, manufacture, possess, sell, purchase, transport, use or consume any narcotic drug or psychotropic substance.
8.punishment: Varies by quantity (small / intermediate / commercial) — see Sections 15–22

20.title: Punishment for Contravention relating to Cannabis
20.plain_language: Punishment for producing, possessing, selling, buying, transporting or using cannabis (ganja, charas, etc.).
20.punishment: Small qty: up to 1 year; Intermediate: up to 10 years; Commercial qty: 10–20 years rigorous imprisonment

21.title: Punishment for Contravention relating to Manufactured Drugs
21.plain_language: Punishment for offences related to manufactured drugs (e.g. heroin, morphine) and preparations containing them.
21.punishment: Small qty: up to 1 year; Intermediate: up to 10 years; Commercial qty: 10–20 years rigorous imprisonment

22.title: Punishment for Contravention relating to Psychotropic Substances
22.plain_language: Punishment for offences relating to psychotropic substances (e.g. amphetamines, LSD, certain prescription drugs misused).
22.punishment: Small qty: up to 1 year; Intermediate: up to 10 years; Commercial qty: 10–20 years rigorous imprisonment

POCSO.fullName: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012

4.title: Punishment for Penetrative Sexual Assault
4.plain_language: Punishment for penetrative sexual assault on a child (under 18). Covers acts defined under Section 3.
4.punishment: Minimum 7 years up to Life Imprisonment + fine

6.title: Punishment for Aggravated Penetrative Sexual Assault
6.plain_language: Aggravated form — offence committed by police, armed forces, public servant, or in a position of trust/authority; or on a child below 12.
6.punishment: Minimum 20 years up to Life Imprisonment or Death + fine

8.title: Punishment for Sexual Assault
8.plain_language: Sexual assault on a child (non-penetrative but with sexual intent — touching private parts, etc.).

10.title: Punishment for Aggravated Sexual Assault
10.plain_language: Aggravated form of sexual assault — by police, armed forces, or persons in authority over the child.

25.title: Punishment for Certain Offences (Unlicensed Arms)
25.plain_language: Possessing, carrying, or using firearms or ammunition without a valid license.
25.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or fine, or both; enhanced for prohibited arms

27.title: Punishment for Using Arms, etc.
27.plain_language: Using any firearm or imitation firearm in contravention of law — discharging a weapon in public or threatening with it.
27.punishment: Minimum 3 years up to 7 years imprisonment

184.title: Driving Dangerously
184.plain_language: Driving a motor vehicle at a speed or in a manner which is dangerous to the public, given road/traffic conditions.
184.punishment: First offence: up to 6 months or ₹1,000–5,000; Second offence: up to 2 years or ₹10,000

185.title: Driving by a Drunken Person or by a Person under the Influence of Drugs
185.plain_language: Driving while blood alcohol content exceeds the legal limit (30 mg/100 ml) or under influence of drugs.
185.punishment: First offence: up to 6 months or ₹10,000; Second offence: up to 2 years or ₹15,000

196.title: Driving an Uninsured Vehicle
196.plain_language: Driving a motor vehicle in a public place without a valid third-party insurance policy.
196.punishment: Up to 3 months imprisonment or ₹2,000 fine, or both

66.title: Computer Related Offences
66.plain_language: Dishonestly or fraudulently doing any act prohibited under Section 43 — includes hacking, unauthorized access, data theft, virus spreading.
66.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or ₹5 lakh fine, or both

66C.title: Punishment for Identity Theft
66C.plain_language: Fraudulently or dishonestly using another person's electronic signature, password, or unique identification feature.
66C.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment + ₹1 lakh fine

66D.title: Punishment for Cheating by Personation using Computer Resource
66D.plain_language: Cheating someone by pretending to be another person using a computer, mobile, or communication device (e.g. fake profiles, phishing).
66D.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment + ₹1 lakh fine

67.title: Punishment for Publishing Obscene Material in Electronic Form
67.plain_language: Publishing or transmitting obscene material (text, image, video) in electronic form that would deprave and corrupt readers/viewers.
67.punishment: First: up to 3 years + ₹5 lakh fine; Second: up to 5 years + ₹10 lakh fine
